rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken term for a towed dwelling vehicle used as a caravan.

example.english: We towed our caravan into the campsite.
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gaa3 to1 kaa1 jap6 zo2 jing4 dei6

rows.note: This is the all-purpose term for a travelling caravan of traders, cargo, and vehicles or animals.

example.english: The caravan travelled through the desert for several days.
example.traditional: 商隊沿住沙漠行咗幾日。
example.jyutping: soeng1 deoi6 jyun4 zyu6 saa1 mok6 haang4 zo2 gei2 jat6

rows.note: Use this specifically when the caravan is a group of camels crossing a desert.

example.english: The camel caravan crossed the desert and travelled for three days.
example.traditional: 駱駝隊穿過沙漠，行咗三日。
example.jyutping: lok3 to4 deoi6 cyun1 gwo3 saa1 mok6 haang4 zo2 saam1 jat6
